wsjHeadlines.description: The Bank of Japan answered U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s call to raise rates, but the yen still weakened, potentially creating a new concern for Bessent, who helped lead the first coordinated support for the yen since 1998 earlier this summer.
